title: The Etheridge Project: An Encomium on Henry VIII and Elizabeth I by George Etheridge (BL Royal MS 16 C X)

notes: Electronic edition of a Greek encomium in Etheridge's own hand, prepared for Elizabeth I's Oxford visit of 1566, with transcription, edited text with apparatus, English translation and manuscript images.
